title: Brunnenstraße, Neu Isenburg
description:
Stylishly Renovated Apartment with Garden – Living Comfort in Neu-Isenburg

This beautifully renovated apartment combines historic charm with modern living. Exposed brick walls give the home a unique loft-like character, while underfloor heating ensures a cozy atmosphere throughout the year. The apartment is fully furnished and designed for one person – ideal for expats and professionals looking for comfort close to Frankfurt.

Apartment Highlights:

Tastefully renovated historic building with exposed brick walls

Underfloor heating in all rooms

Fully furnished with modern décor

Separate laundry room with private washing machine

Spacious shared garden – perfect for relaxing outdoors

High-speed internet – ideal for home office and streaming

Location:
The apartment is situated in Neu-Isenburg, a quiet and green neighborhood with excellent connections. Shops, cafés, and restaurants are within walking distance. Both Frankfurt city center and the airport can be reached in just a few minutes.

Frankfurt Airport: approx. 10 minutes by car

Frankfurt City Center: approx. 15 minutes by car or S-Bahn

Direct access to A3, A5, and A661 highways

Perfect for:
Expats, business commuters, and singles looking for a stylish home with garden access and excellent connections. Not suitable for families.

title: Ludwigstraße, Neu Isenburg
description:
This fully furnished 2-room apartment offers 57 m2 of comfortable living space on the ground floor, featuring a large terrace with a private garden (~30 m2) — perfect for relaxing after work or enjoying weekends outdoors.

The apartment includes:

Living-dining room and bedroom, fully equipped with bed, sofa, wardrobe, dining table & chairs, and garden furniture.

Modern kitchen with dishwasher, oven, stove, airfryer, rice cooker, kettle, and complete cookware & tableware.

Bathroom with shower in bathtub, Washing machine/dryer in the basement, fast Wi-Fi, and a large flat TV.

Workspace/desk ideal for remote work or business tasks.

Location highlights:

Quiet residential oasis next to the city forest, perfect for walks year-round.

2 min walk to Tram 17 (14 min to Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof), 15–20 min by car to city center, 18 min to Frankfurt Airport.

Supermarket, restaurants, and cafés within 8 min walk.

Ideal for: business professionals, expats, or relocation tenants seeking a comfortable, high-quality temporary home with easy access to Frankfurt city and the airport. Minimum stay 1–6 months.
